title: Ihamagara rivuye mu kiyaya ceranda
intro: Hirya y’amapaji y’amateka hari inkuru y’umutima wari uhagaze hagati y’umutware w’inkomezi n’abantu bose bari mu buja. Uwo muntu yahamagariwe gukiza ihanga ububisha, akora ibitangaro biteye kubiri n’itegeko ryose ry’akameremere. Kuva ku musozi mweranda gushika ku gitangaro co ku mazi, uwo musavyi wa Allah yarabonye ibimenyetso vyosubiramwo mu bihe vyose. Igikorwa cawe uno musi ni ukumenya uwo muntu atangaje iragi ryiwe ryahinduye inzira y’amateka y’abantu.
clues: Navutse mu gihe abantu banje bari bahanganye n’itegeko ry’urupfu, umuryango wanje unshira mu mazi kugira ngo nkize ubuzima bwanje.
Nabonetse kandi ndakurira mu rugo nyene rw’umutware yari yategetse ko abantu bo mu bwoko bwanje bicwa.
Nahungiye ku musozi mweranda aho nabonye umuriro uri ku giti kitaturitse, ijwi rirambwira rivuye kuri wo.
Nasubijwe kuri uwo mutware nyene n’ibitangaro, nsaba umwidegemvyo w’abantu banje bari mu buja.
Nakubitishije ikiyaga inkoni yanje, kigacamwo amabarabara yumutse, kimira abakurikirana abantu banje.
Navuganye n’Umukama wanje ku musozi amajoro mirongo ine, maze mpabwa ibipande vy’ubuyobozi bw’Imana.
